design.title: RunContext — Lifecycle-Aware Lock Management
design.summary: Extract lock management into a RunContext class that owns cwd + lock state + signal handler cleanup. Eliminates process.cwd() usage in signal handlers (bug) and scattered lock acquire/release code (20+ sites).
key_decisions: Static factory (not constructor) — lock acquisition can fail
Per-context signal handlers (not global) — correct cwd in closure
ctx.run(fn) for guaranteed cleanup — replaces try/finally
Idempotent release — safe to call multiple times
Lock-free create() variant — for commands that don't need locks
LockConflictError typed error — replaces console.error + process.exit
bug_fixes: cli.ts:773 — main().catch() used process.cwd() instead of --cwd value
cli.ts:779 — SIGINT handler used process.cwd() instead of --cwd value
cli.ts:784 — SIGTERM handler used process.cwd() instead of --cwd value
design.scope_boundary: orchestrator.ts and downstream modules keep cwd:string params. RunContext wraps lock.ts, does not replace it.
